description: Look up many driver file hashes in the LOLDrivers catalog at once, each with the fields of driver_lookup. Hashes beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed. Costs 1 credit per hash looked up, at least 1.

hashes.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of driver files or of their Authentihash

name: driver_lookup_bulk

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

available.description: false while the catalog is not loaded. null when no hash was read.

license.description: Always Apache-2.0, the license of the catalog.

reason.description: not_synced. Present only when available is false.

failed.description: Looked-up hashes whose stored data could not be read. They have no result. A hash the catalog does not hold is no failure: its result has found false.

not_processed.description: Hashes the credit budget did not cover, in lower case. They were not looked up.

processed.description: Well-formed hashes that were looked up. Equals successful + failed.

results.description: One result for each hash that was read, in request order.

found.description: true when at least one driver file carries the hash, false when none does. null while the catalog is not loaded.

hash.description: The hash as sent, in lower case.

hash_type.description: md5, sha1 or sha256, from the length of the hash.

match_count.description: Driver files that carry the hash. matches lists at most 16. null while the catalog is not loaded.

matches.description: At most 16 driver files, in driver_id order. [] when none matches or the catalog is not loaded.

items.description: One driver file that carries the hash. A text the catalog leaves empty is null.

attack_technique_ids.description: ATT&CK technique ids as one comma-separated text, such as T1542, T1068. It is not an array.

catalog_added.description: YYYY-MM-DD the catalog added the entry.

command.description: The catalog's command text, only with include_commands true. null otherwise, and always in driver_lookup_bulk.

cve_ids.description: CVE ids the catalog files the driver under.

detection_rules.description: Detection rules, mostly a type and a value. Use them as context, not as blocking rules.

items.description: A text, or an object of texts.

driver_id.description: The catalog id of the driver.

matched_driver_file.description: The driver file that carries the hash.

authentihash.description: Authenticode hashes. They stay the same when the driver is signed again.

imphash.description: The hash of the import table. A lookup does not match on it.

loads_despite_hvci.description: true when Windows loads the driver with memory integrity (HVCI) on, false when it refuses it. null when the catalog does not say.

original_file_name.description: The name the file's version resource gives. It can differ from file_name.

matched_on.description: The hashes of the file that equal the hash: md5, sha1, sha256, authentihash_md5, authentihash_sha1 or authentihash_sha256.

operating_system.description: The Windows versions the catalog names.

privileges.description: The privileges that use needs, such as kernel.

items.description: A text, or an object of texts.

tags.description: Names for hunting, mostly file names.

items.description: A text, or an object of texts.

use_case.description: What an attacker uses the driver for, such as Elevate privileges.

skipped.description: Elements that are not a well-formed hash. They cost nothing.

successful.description: Hashes with a result in results, found or not.

total.description: Elements submitted. Equals processed + skipped + the length of not_processed.

title: Bulk Windows Driver Lookup
